description: A quant algorithm that replicates the 12 seed alpha factors from the LLM-driven framework (arXiv:2409.06289) with pre-trained MLP weights, constructs a cross-sectional long-short portfolio on the SSE 50 universe, and applies basic risk controls and typical A-share transaction costs.
risk_controls: Stop-loss per position at -10% unrealised PnL
Positions sized only on valid insights with confidence > 0.5 (hardcoded 0.8 in this draft)
Portfolio long/short exposure proportional to signal strength via equal-weighting of Up/Down categories

data_requirements.field: open, high, low, close, volume, amount
